findings.evidence: template/scripts/requirement_intake.py:267 reconciles work identity before membership confirmation at line 270. Identity reconciliation appends `Work identity: BR-N` to the Issue body (template/scripts/managed_work_identity.py:51), but retry lookup compares that stored body with the original rendered body at requirement_intake.py:290. An in-memory probe confirmed that Issue #42 with its generated identity line returns no match. This violates the active delta's retry guarantee at openspec/changes/requirement-project-membership/specs/managed-task-intake/spec.md:22.
findings.summary: Rerunning create after a Project failure creates another Requirement instead of continuing the durable Issue.

findings.evidence: template/scripts/requirement_intake.py:281 and :324 invoke `gh api --paginate` and pass its output to managed_task.run_json. The installed CLI documentation states that each page is a separate JSON array or object; template/scripts/managed_task.py:233 parses the entire output as one JSON document. An in-memory probe with two page arrays raised `ManagedTaskError: gh api did not return structured JSON`. With more than 100 open Requirements, create cannot perform retry lookup and reconcile-board --all cannot execute the operator recovery promised by design.md:9 and docs/engineering/task-intake.md:93.
findings.summary: Creation and bulk board reconciliation fail when open Requirements span multiple API pages.
